newsitem.title: USA: Magna Group completes Homeland deal.
newsitem.headline: Magna Group completes Homeland deal.

text.p: Magna Group Inc said Friday it completed its acquisition of Homeland Bancshares Corp of Waterloo, Iowa, effective March 1.

Under the terms of the agreement, Magna will issue 5,038,934 shares of Magna common stock and $92,012,638 in cash for the 5,703,378 shares of Homeland common stock. The transaction has a current total market value of about $252 million.

Based on the average price of Magna stock during the 10 trading day valuation period from February 5 to 19, each share of Homeland common stock may be exchanged for about 1.418 shares of Magna common stock, or about $42.80 in cash.
The terms of the merger agreement gave Homeland shareholders the choice of receiving Magna stock, cash, or a combination, subject to certain limitations.
Magna said the merger gives it a significant presence in Illinois, Iowa, and Missouri.
Homeland had $1.2 billion in assets and 30 locations, and Magna Group has $6.6 billion in assets and 137 banking locations.
